limitations: 中文咬字与部分逐字时间仍需验收
两路和声为全曲复音估计，以 u/o 母音合成；声部归属、八度及原唱和声词仍待校验
贝斯与 BBox 为分析所得近似编配，全部声音由 Chimera 生成

harmony.method: DIO + StoneMask on separated backing group; strongest monophonic estimate, not recovery of individual original singers

bass.method: Low-pass instrumental analysis + DIO/StoneMask; provisional bass approximation

percussion.method: Band-energy onset estimates from instrumental reference, not exact drum transcription

polyphonicHarmony.method: Whitened harmonic-template nonnegative decomposition + continuity Viterbi, two independently scored contours from backing-only reference
polyphonicHarmony.limits: Polyphonic estimate with possible octave, leakage and voice-assignment errors; not ground truth. No fixed-interval lead copies; no source audio in output.

harmonyRenderer: Independent backing lyric scores; continuous native Chimera engines; no lead timing copied

gapTreatment.intro: reconstructed da/la scat from supplied syllable pattern and backing template alignment
gapTreatment.reply: 想未来, selected by both-channel constrained acoustic matching; own ASR syllable times
gapTreatment.outro: Woo, sustained rounded vocable with source-derived pitch and voiced onset/release

bridge.action: excluded as low-level central lead residue, not an independent harmony line
bridge.evidence: vocal correlation 0.48 vs instrumental 0.07; backing RMS 0.0127 vs reference vocal 0.126; stereo correlation 0.941
bridge.classification: acoustic attribution, not ground-truth isolated stems

independentBacking.limitations: Template-based reconstruction; stereo voices remain mixtures; 104s residue attribution inferred

dictionRevision.selection: Paired unchanged timing/pitch comparisons; no recognizer worsened on selected cases
dictionRevision.notCertified: ASR is not a perceptual intelligibility guarantee

timingLimits: Acoustic timing estimates; weak CTC anchors retained; not listening-certified
